title: First Communion
summary: Paddy's young nephew has his First Communion. Billy comes along as moral support but treats the whole thing like an anthropological field trip, asking increasingly inappropriate questions.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy at the garden fence. Paddy wears a formal shirt and tie, looking nervous. Billy in his usual blue polo but slightly smarter. Morning light, both holding tea mugs.
Wide shot of both men walking down a Belfast street towards a Catholic church visible in distance. Camera slowly pans to follow their movement. Red brick terraced houses line the street.
Close-up on Billy's face, eyebrows raised in confusion. Static camera. He's clearly processing information and looking puzzled.
Extreme close-up on Paddy's horrified face, eyes wide with shock. Static camera holding on his expression of disbelief.
Wide shot outside the church entrance. Families in formal wear gathered. Derek appears from behind a parked car wearing completely inappropriate casual clothes, waving cheerfully.
scenes.narration: Inappropriate commentary arrives precisely on schedule.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy, both looking mortified. Paddy covers his face with his hands. Billy looks around nervously at other families nearby.
Close-up on Billy's face as he leans in conspiratorially toward camera. His expression is genuinely curious but completely oblivious to appropriateness.
Extreme close-up on Paddy's face, his eye twitching with barely contained rage. Static camera holding on the eye twitch.
Medium two-shot of both men back at the fence, now in the afternoon. Both look exhausted. Paddy loosened his tie, Billy's hair slightly disheveled. They hold tea mugs.
Close-up on both men's faces in profile, sharing a moment of understanding. Soft afternoon light, both smiling slightly despite themselves.
